{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows positive bias (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows mean reversion toward lower prices.",
    "Increase forecast if sentiment history includes a recent +0.50 or higher, indicating bullish momentum.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, delay peak forecast by 1-2 days.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 75% of recent 5-day high to prevent overshoot.",
    "If sentiment history includes a -0.25 or lower, reduce forecast by 5-15% to account for bearish sentiment.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, apply smoothing: if true outcome deviates >10% from 14-day moving average, adjust forecast toward that average."
  ]
}
